program_name: Bachelor of Applied Science (Maritime Technology) with Honours (Dual Degree)
program_name_malay: Sarjana Muda Sains Gunaan (Teknologi Maritim) dengan Kepujian (Dual Degree)
duration: 4 years (3 years/6 semesters at UMT + 1 year/2 semesters at ITS)

fees.notes: International tuition per UMT's official Undergraduate Programme Fees schedule (Jan 2026): USD 1,050 per semester for Bachelor of Applied Science (Maritime Technology) with Honours (Dual Degree). The UMT portion is 6 semesters/3 years (official programme page; a further 2 semesters/1 year is spent at Institut Teknologi Sepuluh Nopember and is not covered by the UMT schedule), so total shown = USD 6,300 for the UMT portion and per_year = USD 2,100 (derived). Sources: https://www.umt.edu.my/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/yuran-pengajian-undergrad.pdf, https://www.umt.edu.my/sarjana-muda-sains-gunaan-teknologi-maritim-dengan-kepujian-dual-degree-ftkk/ (accessed 2026-09-18).
